title: Agencia Estatal de Meteorología
description: Agencia Estatal de Meteorología - AEMET is a governmental agency of Spain that provides comprehensive meteorological services, including weather observation, predictions, and climate analytics. It serves various sectors such as agriculture, aviation, maritime activities, and emergency services. AEMET aims to support public safety and management through accurate weather forecasts, climate data, and educational resources. The agency also engages in research and international collaboration to enhance meteorological science and technology.
